title: A tri-specific antibody engages T and myeloid cells to augment anti-tumor immunity
summary: Immunologically inert tumors often resist immune checkpoint inhibitors due to a scarcity of tumor-specific T cells and the immunosuppressive microenvironment, despite pronounced and functional bystander T cell infiltration. Here, we develop a novel tri-specific T cell engager (Tri-TCE) designed in a unique format to redirect T cells while mitigating immunosuppression.
